## smoke_bugs

```yaml
- id: tsf_nan_from_missing_values
  symptom: NaN loss or metrics, or a distribution-constraint error (Chi2/StudentT
    df constraint) mid-training or at evaluation.
  likely_cause: 'Blank cells in real tables become NaN at the loader (documented behavior),
    the notebook aggregates with += and no missing-value policy, and NaN flows into
    training targets or ground truth. Fix at the aggregation seam. Sanitizing the
    model''s inputs (np.nan_to_num inside forecast) is the band-aid shape: it turns
    a loud crash into a silent NaN metric.

    '
  fix: r2c-notebook-generator
  status: seed
- id: tsf_withheld_target_tail
  symptom: Metrics are NaN or identically zero on the last-K evaluation window while
    the model and weights are entirely finite.
  likely_cause: 'The public source withholds the target over its final period (competition
    layout), so the nominal axis outlives the usable extent and the held-out tail
    carries no ground truth. Evaluate on the last window that has data; state where
    usable data ends.

    '
  fix: r2c-notebook-generator
  status: seed
- id: tsf_declared_vs_realized_dims
  symptom: RuntimeError 'expected N, got M' at the decoder or LSTM input, typically
    two layers away from the cause.
  likely_cause: "Declared context/feature dimensions disagree with the bundle's realized\
    \ axis (e.g. 10 declared lags over a 4-step axis, silently clamped into a width-4\
    \ slice). The root is bundle axis coverage or a silent clamp \u2014 validate declared\
    \ dimensions against realized data and raise with the arithmetic in the message.\n"
  fix: r2c-architecture-coder
  status: seed
- id: tsf_unconstrained_distribution_params
  symptom: 'NaN loss or sampling errors: scale is non-positive or degrees-of-freedom
    drifts below its support.'
  likely_cause: The output head emits raw logits for scale/df without softplus plus
    a floor, or the loss does not constrain them.
  fix: r2c-architecture-coder
  status: seed
- id: tsf_graph_no_edges
  symptom: Relational encoder produces constant or zero embeddings; all nodes isolated
    (graph-based methods only).
  likely_cause: Similarity threshold too high for the demo's sparse features yields
    a graph with no edges; aggregation over empty neighborhoods returns zeros.
  fix: r2c-method-coder
  status: seed
- id: tsf_string_cast_real_columns
  symptom: 'ValueError: could not convert string to float during data preparation.'
  likely_cause: Real tables carry string ids, dates, and categorical columns; a blanket
    float cast dies on them. Use the loader's typed columns and parse dates explicitly.
  fix: r2c-notebook-generator
  status: seed
```

## semantic_checks

```yaml
- id: TSF-analyzer-horizon-context
  stage: stage_1_analyzer
  check: 'The spec records the forecast horizon K and context length P as structural
    parameters with provenance. These determine tensor shapes and window arithmetic,
    not optional scale knobs.

    '
  silent_failure: A missing horizon leaves the coder guessing the output shape; a
    wrong context length truncates the input window silently.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-analyzer-protocol-axis-arithmetic
  stage: stage_1_analyzer
  check: 'The role-typed protocol keeps one-call forecast horizon separate from evaluation
    coverage. For a stated single holdout, the static bundle floor is context length
    + validation span + test span after positive integral conversion to one shared
    unit/granularity. Other evaluation schemes need their own typed origin/fold/window
    controls rather than this arithmetic.

    '
  silent_failure: A raw bundle-axis count is compared with context, validation, or
    test quantities on a different cadence; or the test span is copied into one-call
    K, so a structurally infeasible bundle passes under false arithmetic.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-arch-encoder-decoder-connected
  stage: stage_2b_architecture
  check: "Any relational/graph encoder output actually reaches the temporal decoder\
    \ on the executed data path \u2014 constructed but never-called projection or\
    \ encoder modules are a failure, not dead weight.\n"
  silent_failure: 'The encoder exists in model.py but the decoder receives only raw
    history; the paper''s relational contribution is silently absent (pdfgnn 2026-08-04:
    dead decoder_projection).'
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-arch-per-series-scaling
  stage: stage_2b_architecture
  probe: time_series_forecasting.magnitude_collapse
  check: 'When the paper''s lineage normalizes targets per series (DeepAR and the
    PyTorch Forecasting stack do by default), per-series scale handling exists in
    the pipeline, or its absence is a disclosed deviation.

    '
  silent_failure: Unnormalized targets in the hundreds collapse the predicted mean
    toward zero while sigma inflates; the loss curve falls and the delivered model
    is indistinguishable from predicting zero (pdfgnn 2026-08-06).
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-method-distribution-not-point
  stage: stage_2c_method
  probe: time_series_forecasting.sample_genuineness
  check: 'The pluggable returns genuine probabilistic output: samples are real draws
    with spread consistent with the scale parameter, and no returned field aliases
    another (mean vs mu may be equal in value, never the same tensor doing double
    duty as "samples").

    '
  silent_failure: 'Trajectories that are conditional means dressed as Monte Carlo
    samples: measured spread 5.6e-5 against sigma 0.74, intervals ~10,000x too narrow
    (pdfgnn night3).'
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-method-autoregressive-feedback
  stage: stage_2c_method
  probe: time_series_forecasting.path_dependence
  check: 'When the paper''s decoder is autoregressive (DeepAR-style ancestral sampling),
    the sampled value at step k conditions step k+1. A single forward pass emitting
    K independent marginals is a mechanism substitution, not an approximation.

    '
  silent_failure: Cumulative-horizon distributions misstate the variance of the sum;
    three consecutive pdfgnn rolls shipped three different substitutions (mean-feeding,
    broken return signature, rollout deleted outright).
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-method-own-history-sensitive
  stage: stage_2c_method
  probe: time_series_forecasting.own_history_sensitivity
  check: 'Each series'' forecast responds to a material change in that same series''
    eligible history while all other declared inputs, relational metadata, and stable
    entity ordering remain fixed.

    '
  silent_failure: A severed self-signal path leaves an entity's forecast unchanged
    even when its own nonzero history is multiplied by 100, while cross-series or
    bias terms make the output look nonconstant.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-method-no-target-in-decoder-input
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: 'Training-time decoder inputs at forecast positions carry only lagged or
    known-in-advance values, never the training target, and the training-time input
    construction matches the inference-time construction on every channel.

    '
  silent_failure: 'The demand channel at forecast positions equals the target during
    training and is zeroed at inference: optimistically biased fits, structurally
    handicapped serving (pdfgnn loop2: torch.equal(dec_input[:, P:, 0], target) was
    True).'
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-method-synchronized-batching
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: 'When the paper uses synchronized batching (all series in a batch share one
    time window), the training loop enforces the alignment on real batch construction,
    not vacuously on a single window.

    '
  silent_failure: Random per-series offsets make relational aggregation mix timestamps;
    or one-window training satisfies the property trivially while covering 3% of the
    axis.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-method-time-stride-independent
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: "The training loop's time-window stride is its own quantity \u2014 never\
    \ the series batch size \u2014 and the loop visits the training windows the protocol\
    \ implies.\n"
  silent_failure: 't += batch_size uses the series-batch size as the time stride:
    4 of ~127 windows visited, 88% of history never a target, and raising batch_size
    for throughput silently cuts training data (pdfgnn loop2).'
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-notebook-chronology-preserved
  stage: stage_3a_notebook
  check: 'Temporal aggregation keys carry the year (e.g. isocalendar year*100+week),
    the resulting axis is strictly chronological, and multi-year data is never folded
    onto one seasonal calendar.

    '
  silent_failure: groupby(week-of-year) sums January 2017+2018+2019 into one bucket;
    the '52-week series' is a seasonal aggregate and every downstream number runs
    on a fabricated axis (pdfgnn night3).
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-notebook-missing-value-policy
  stage: stage_3a_notebook
  check: 'Aggregation over real tables states and applies an explicit missing-value
    policy. Blank cells arrive from the loader as NaN; they must be handled at the
    aggregation seam, never sanitized deep inside the model (np.nan_to_num at the
    crash site converts a loud, routable failure into a silent NaN metric).

    '
  silent_failure: One blank row poisons a whole aggregation bucket; 126 NaN cells
    reach training and the evaluation, and the delivered metrics print nan (pdfgnn
    loop2).
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-notebook-eval-window-held-out-with-signal
  stage: stage_3a_notebook
  check: 'The metric window is disjoint from training AND the forecast''s conditioning
    context, and it carries signal: held-out actuals are finite and not identically
    zero. Disjointness alone is not enough when the dataset''s tail withholds the
    target.

    '
  silent_failure: A correctly held-out window sits entirely inside the source's withheld-target
    dead tail; RMSE prints nan over 56 missing and 64 fabricated-zero cells (pdfgnn
    loop2 headline finding).
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-notebook-loss-series-visible
  stage: stage_3a_notebook
  check: 'The training cell emits exactly one canonical R2C_TRAINING_HISTORY_JSON
    record returned by the fixed helper. It binds finite ordered losses, fitting and
    selection ranges, seed/configuration, target-scaling state, model, and checkpoint;
    reports and probes consume the pipeline-owned artifact rather than parsing printed
    prose.

    '
  silent_failure: A plausible loss list is detached from the split, scaling state,
    selected checkpoint, and evaluated model, so training evidence from one model
    can support another.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-notebook-naive-baselines
  stage: stage_3a_notebook
  probe: time_series_forecasting.holdout_skill
  check: 'The evaluation prints predict-zero and repeat-last-value baselines beside
    the model''s metrics; emits one structured R2C_DEMO_EVALUATION_JSON record from
    executed actuals, model predictions, and pre-window history; and derives its presentation
    verdict from those values and wins against both predict-zero and repeat-last under
    the family demo_skill policy. The pipeline''s skill status separately requires
    its trusted valid-evaluation receipt.

    '
  silent_failure: A model clears the predict-zero degeneracy floor and prints PASS
    while losing to repeat-last minimum competence, or prose is treated as evidence
    despite an invalid split (pdfgnn loop2 and current roll).
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: TSF-params-horizon-positive
  stage: stage_2x_params
  check: forecast_horizon > 0 and context_length > 0; both stated in the paper or
    derived from its protocol.
  silent_failure: A zero horizon produces an empty forecast that still passes smoke
    gates.
  severity: error
  status: seed
```

## pluggable_component

```yaml
name: forecast
return_type: ForecastResult
signature_template: forecast(model, history, static_features, time_varying_features,
  graph, entity_ids, target_scaling_state, seed, *paradigm_extras_by_name) -> ForecastResult
contract:
  fixed_positional_args:
  - model
  - history
  - static_features
  - time_varying_features
  - graph
  - entity_ids
  - target_scaling_state
  seed_param: seed
  paradigm_extras_forwarding: by_name_from_config
  forbidden_param_names:
  - config
return_type_definition: 'ForecastResult is a dataclass defined in method/method.py
  with fields:

  - mean: torch.Tensor  # (N, K) expected value in original target units for N series
  over K future steps

  - variance: torch.Tensor  # (N, K) uncertainty in squared original target units
  (document the exact semantics: scale**2 vs true variance)

  - samples: torch.Tensor  # (num_samples, N, K) Monte Carlo draws in original target
  units

  - distribution_params: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]  # parameters with target-valued
  location/scale restored to original units; dimensionless params (e.g. Student-t
  df) stay unchanged

  '
rationale: "The pluggable takes a trained model, historical values, static\nper-series\
  \ features, known time-varying covariates, the inter-series\nstructure (graph adjacency\
  \ / edge index; None for methods without\none), the exact typed stable entity ids\
  \ for the series axis, and the\ntraining-only target-scaling state keyed by those\
  \ ids. It joins\nscales by typed identity rather than row position and uses the\
  \ fixed\nmethod.target_scaling.inverse_forecast_output helper to return every\n\
  target-valued field in the original target units: mean/location and\nsamples multiply\
  \ by scale, distribution scale multiplies by the\nabsolute scale, and variance multiplies\
  \ by squared scale. It must\nreturn distribution parameters or samples \u2014 not\
  \ just a point\nestimate \u2014 because the family's value is\ndecision-making under\
  \ uncertainty. samples must be genuine draws\n(measurable spread consistent with\
  \ the scale parameter), never\naliased conditional means. The seed parameter makes\
  \ sampling\nreproducible; num_samples is forwarded by name, never hardcoded.\n"
```

## demo_skill

```yaml
schema_version: 1.0.0
primary_metric:
  id: rmse
  direction: lower_is_better
  aggregation: root_mean_squared_error
  units: target_units
eligibility:
  minimum_finite_rows: 1
  require_nonzero_actuals: true
decision_policy: all_required
comparators:
- id: predict_zero
  role: degeneracy_floor
  implementation: predict_zero
  required: true
  absolute_margin: 0.0
  tolerance: 1.0e-12
- id: repeat_last
  role: minimum_competence
  implementation: repeat_last_pre_window
  required: true
  absolute_margin: 0.0
  tolerance: 1.0e-12
```

## arch_contract_requirements

```yaml
required_blocks:
  data_loader.load_data_returns:
    type: dict[str, shape_string]
  architecture.model:
    required_subblocks:
    - class_name
    - forward.input
    - forward.output_type
  pluggable_component.name:
    must_equal: pluggable_component.name
  training_loop.function_name:
    must_equal: train_model
  training_loop.input_shapes:
    type: dict[str, shape_string]
    min_keys:
    - model
    - entity_ids
    - targets
    - fitting_range
    - selection_range
    - seed
    - config_id
symbol_conventions:
  N: number of series (articles/sensors/locations)
  T: number of time steps on the realized axis
  P: context length (historical steps conditioned on)
  K: forecast horizon (future steps predicted)
```
